name: agy-cloud-bridge
author: guaidashu
description: Zero-dependency Cloud <-> Local Antigravity (agy) collaboration gateway: offload heavy AI coding & builds to the cloud to reduce local SSD wear and extend laptop lifespan.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js bridge/*.mjs test/*.test.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && bash -n scripts/handoff.sh scripts/cloud-sync-gate.sh start.sh stop.sh deploy/proxy/agy-proxy-launcher.sh.example
